summary: The extraction volumes, bead/PK and master-mix arithmetic, Table 1 values, OT-2 timings and qPCR program all match the paper and the recovered manuals. The remaining problems are coverage gaps (88 of 141 samples, no extraction negative control, no VTM transfer step) and a few practical omissions, none of which change reported numbers. The automated check raised no findings.

issues.issue: No step moves the 500 µL VTM from the swab tubes into sample_plate, although step 1 assumes the plate is already filled. The paper starts from individual swab tubes stored at 4 °C. Step 1 also adds GTC to open positive samples with no mixing step before the heat step.
issues.suggestion: Add an explicit step (manual or robotic) that aliquots 500 µL VTM from each swab tube into sample_plate, and note the biosafety handling. Optionally mix after the GTC addition.

issues.issue: The layout covers only 88 of the 141 samples. The remaining 53 are not enumerated. The paper says negative controls were included in all runs, but no extraction negative control exists, only qPCR NTCs. The mock-sample series (standard, low and very low viral load, in triplicate) used for the extraction efficiency calculation is also omitted. These omissions are disclosed in the assumptions.
issues.suggestion: Add a second-batch layout (53 samples plus controls) or state the daily batching. Add an extraction negative well, for example VTM+GTC with no sample, to each method. Say explicitly that the efficiency experiment is out of scope.

issues.issue: After the magnet is disengaged and 100 µL elution buffer is added, the beads are never resuspended. The paper says the beads are resuspended in elution buffer, with a 30 s wait off the magnet. Dispensing without mixing may leave the beads dry on the well wall and reduce the eluted RNA.
issues.suggestion: Add a mix step after the elution buffer (for example pipette 5 times at about 50–80 µL), marked as assumed, before the 30 s wait. Alternatively flag this as an unspecified detail of the paper's OT-2 script.

issues.issue: The assumed transfer of the full 100 µL of eluate is unrealistic because some volume is lost to dead volume and bead carryover. Only 5 µL per qPCR well is needed, and 15 µL is taken per well across the three assays.
issues.suggestion: Transfer a slightly smaller volume, for example 90 µL, or state that it is aspirated slowly from the well bottom with the magnet engaged. Mark the volume as assumed.

issues.issue: The diluted positive control is prepared as 50 µL, but nine plates use 5 µL each (45 µL) with no overage. Dead volume in a 1.5 mL tube makes this likely insufficient for robotic aspiration.
issues.suggestion: Scale up the dilution, for example 20 µL control plus 80 µL water, or add 10% or more overage.

issues.issue: On each plate, positive control (A12) is dispensed before the NTC (B12) in adjacent wells. If the same tip or a multichannel head is used, the NTC risks contamination from the template control.
issues.suggestion: Dispense the NTC before the positive control, with a fresh tip for each, and add the positive control last.
